definitions.gloss: to drink bubble tea; to get bubble tea
definitions.explanation: slang verb meaning to drink or buy tapioca milk tea (bubble tea); derived from タピオカ (tapioca)

examples.english: I had bubble tea today too.

examples.japanese: {毎日|まいにち}タピってるから{太|ふと}っちゃった。
examples.english: I gained weight because I've been drinking bubble tea every day.

notes:
SLANG/TREND:
タピる was popularized during the タピオカブーム (bubble tea boom) in Japan around 2018-2019. It's a playful verb formed from タピオカ (tapioca).

WORD FORMATION:
- タピオカ (tapioca) → タピ (abbreviation) + る (verb ending)
- Similar pattern: ググる (to google), バズる (to go viral)

CONJUGATION (godan る-verb):
- タピる (dictionary)
- タピった (past)
- タピって (te-form)
- タピらない (negative)

RELATED TERMS:
- タピオカ - tapioca pearls
- タピオカミルクティー - bubble milk tea
- タピ{活|かつ} - bubble tea activities (trying different shops)

USAGE NOTE:
Mainly used by young people. May sound dated as the bubble tea trend has passed its peak.
